name: lifty
description: Lifty: finanzas personales (y más) en el celular y la compu, sincronizados.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @lifty/server" "npm run dev -w @lifty/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lifty/web && npm run build -w @lifty/server
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w @lifty/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @lifty/desktop
